# FinRL-DeepSeek: LLM-Infused Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning for Trading Agents

arXiv [2502.07393](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07393) · v1 2025-02-11 · latest 2025-02-11

| Field | Gloss | Quote from the paper |
|---|---|---|
| **task** | Building a risk-sensitive stock trading agent that combines reinforcement learning (CVaR-PPO) with LLM-generated trading recommendations and risk scores from financial news. | “We extend the Conditional Value-at-Risk Proximal Policy Optimization (CPPO) algorithm, by adding risk assessment and trading recommendation signals generated by a LLM from financial news.” |
| **architecture** | LLM scores news per stock/day into recommendation (1-5) and risk (1-5) scores; recommendation scores multiply PPO actions (S_f near 1), and portfolio-weighted risk scores R_f rescale trajectory returns in CVaR-PPO. | “At the end, financial news influence trading actions in two ways: through S_{f} and R_{f} .” |
| **data** | FNSPID financial news (15.7 million records, 1999–2023), subsampled to one article per stock per day (2 million records); Nasdaq-100 stocks, daily. | “We use the FNSPID dataset (Dong et al., 2024), which contains 15.7 million time-aligned financial news records spanning 1999–2023. To reduce LLM API costs, we randomly select a representative news article per stock per day, reducing the dataset to 2 million records.” |
| **window** | Two setups: train 2019–2022, trade 2023; and train 2013–2018, trade 2019-2023. Windows for the 2M-step runs are not stated in text. | “Training Period: 2013–2018 Training Iterations: 400k steps (20 epochs, 20k steps each) Trading Period: 2019-2023” |
| **models** | DeepSeek V3, Qwen 2.5 72B and Llama 3.3 70B for news scoring; PPO and CVaR-PPO RL agents. | “Using LLMs (DeepSeek V3 (DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024), Qwen 2.5 72B (Qwen et al., 2025) Llama 3.3 70B (Grattafiori et al., 2024)), we extract stock recommendations and risk assessment using the following prompts :” |
| **baselines** | Plain PPO and CPPO without LLM signals, and the Nasdaq 100 benchmark. | “In these two runs (RL agents are stochastic), PPO and CPPO-DeepSeek outperform other methods, including the Nasdaq 100 benchmark.” |
| **headline_result** | After 2 million training steps, CPPO-DeepSeek (10%) achieved Information Ratio 0.0078, CVaR -0.0437, Rachev Ratio 0.9818, versus CPPO -0.0148, -0.0439, 1.0404. | “\| CPPO-DeepSeek (100 epochs) \| 0.0078 \| -0.0437 \| 0.9818” |
| **costs** | Only inference-cost consideration: news subsampled to one article per stock per day to reduce LLM API costs. No transaction cost assumptions stated. | “To reduce LLM API costs, we randomly select a representative news article per stock per day, reducing the dataset to 2 million records.” |
